title: Queen of the Succubi (ORIGINAL)
description: You've fought your way through a horde of sex demons and monster girls, to strike deep into the inner circle of their Mistress, the Queen of the Succubi. She's impressed that you've made it this far, appearing still so resistant to her subject's advances, and has chosen now to materialise on the scene of the battle to confront you herself. Seizing at this sudden chance to be immortalised as a hero, you cry out — saying you will put a stop to her evil, once and for all. However, her powerful demonic magic and irresistibly seductive body has already begun to wear away at your heroic resolve. So that even as you yet move, to strike her down. Something about her naked presence stays your hand. A moment of hesitation in the face of beauty, that seals your fate, as she slowly turns to speak.
author: Mistress Shibby
